content: Fiye 25:1-6 Abalaham wapmihiŋiye noli
Abalaham adi hatigane kotigoŋ tam niŋ nagikuk, wou Ketula.
Kaŋ adi mihiŋiye indiŋ yanagikuk: Simlan, Yoksan, Medan, Midian, Isbak eŋ Sua.
Yoksan’walaŋ mihiŋiyat indiŋ mintamiŋgumuk: Seba eŋ Dedaŋ. Kaŋ Dedaŋ’walaŋ mihiye adi indiŋ mintagiŋ: Asulim, Letusim eŋ Leunim.
Midian mihiŋiye adi indiŋ mintagiŋ: Efa, Efel, Hanok, Abida, eŋ Elda. Meeniŋ hogohogok yoŋ adi Ketula’walaŋ yalakiŋiye.
Abalaham adi muneeŋ bomboŋ eŋ nemenemek hogohogok halimguk u agaŋ mihiŋiŋ Aisakdok mindapmaguk.
Iŋgoŋ oŋ adi kaipmuŋ hatiŋale tamuŋiye noli’walaŋ mihiwoi adi adi hogok siloŋ tiyemiŋa yeniŋkulune Aisak bikabuŋa kwet mele labulabuneŋkade wooŋ itowagiŋ.
Abalaham kumuŋguk.
Abalaham adi guletŋiŋ 175 hatiguk.
Adi adi hatige hatige me gawadaaŋ hinek tiŋa nadifonit kumuŋguk. Kumuŋa mamaŋpapaŋiye kumuŋgiŋ adut tomboyoukuk.
Kumumbune mihiŋiyat Aisakdut Ismael adi Makpela kawade mage ginaŋ wenefalagumuk. Kawade mage woŋ adi Mamele gagayeŋ Efelon, Soha Hitait niŋ mihiŋiŋ’walaŋ hewehewe ginaŋ hakuk.
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, hewehewe woŋ e Abalahamdi Hitaithi’walaŋ tuwaguk. Uŋgoŋ Abalaham eŋ taamuŋiŋ Salah yehiwenegiŋ.
Abalaham kumumbune mindaŋkade Bepaŋdi mihiŋiŋ Aisak kahaŋ timiŋguk. Aisak adi adi ime niŋ wou Bea Lahai Loi uŋaŋ itouluguk.
Ismael’walaŋ yalakiŋiye
Yoŋ adi Ismael Abalaham mihiŋiŋ Salah’walaŋ tipilapilaye tam Haga Isip niŋdi Abalahamdok nagikuk adi’walaŋ mede kahat.
Ismael mihiŋiye mintagiŋ indigoŋ tuwot habiyeŋ youkiŋ. Mihiŋiŋ tuwo wou Nebayot, agaŋ Kedal, Adibel, Mibsam
eŋ Misima, Duma, eŋ Masa,
Hadad eŋ Tema, Yetul, Napis eŋ Kedema.
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, meheki u Ismael’walaŋ mihiŋiye ala wouhiye adi yohikwehik eŋ houle yothik itougiŋ wondok tuwolit yoyagiŋ. Adi meeniŋ bop hatitaugiŋ indigoŋ mapmehiye 12 hatigiŋ.
Eŋ Ismael naiŋiŋ diniŋ mebi adi indiŋ. Adi adi hatige hatige guletŋiŋ 137 tubune kumuŋa mamaŋpapaŋiye kumuŋgiŋdut tomboyoukuk.

Adi’walaŋ yalakiŋiye adi Hawil eŋ Sulu lekiŋgoŋhik ginaŋ eŋ Isip kwet gagayeŋ ala Asiliya kwetneŋ weene uŋgoŋ uundok biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, naŋgat dikihiye adi’walaŋ kwet gagayeŋ hatiyagiŋ. Iŋgoŋ menot momooŋgoŋ mu tiyagiŋ.
Esau Eŋ Yakobo
Yoŋ adi Abalaham’walaŋ mihiŋiŋ Aisak’walaŋ mede kahat.
Aisak adi guletŋiŋ 40 tubune tamuŋiŋ Lebeka nagikuk. Lebeka adi Betuel wabiŋiŋ. Betuel adi adi Alam niŋ me eŋ Padan Alam kwetneniŋ. Lebeka wiwi adi Laban. Adi adi me Alamniŋ.
Aisak tamuŋiŋ Lebeka adi kafi hatiguk doktiŋa Aisak adi tamŋiŋ tubulodaaŋ Bepaŋ ninadi tuguk. Kaŋ Wapum adi ninadiŋiŋ nadiguk, kaŋ tamuŋiŋ Lebeka adi mihiwele tuguk.
Kaŋ ŋakŋak lufom adi meehik weleŋ ginaŋ hali kipaŋkipaŋ tubune nadiŋa indiŋ yoguk, “U maŋgoŋde unduŋ mintanamulak?” Unduŋ yoŋa Wapum ninadiguk,

kaŋ Wapumdibo niŋguk, “Meeniŋ bop wapum lufom du’walaŋ walage maaneŋ hakamuk. Ala meeniŋ bop lufom du’walaŋ maaneŋ hakamuk woŋ adi kougoŋ yehidane titindok. Mebop niŋdi bop niŋ yalakapmeeŋ loloŋnit tineeŋ. Eŋ, biyeniŋdi kwayaŋ tipilpilaye timimbaak.”
Wapmihi yanagi yanagit nai ginaŋ weleŋ ginaŋneŋ mihi katap yakat hakumuk.
Mihi tuwo adi folooŋ giminiŋ eŋ dahidahi dumuniŋnit undiniŋ mintaguk, doktiŋa wou Esau youkiŋ.
Kaŋ kwayaŋ mintaguk, adi adi kohoŋdi Esau’walaŋ kayoŋ yahihiliŋiŋ foloŋ honeŋ hakuk doktiŋa wou Yakobo youkiŋ. Aisak adi guletŋiŋ 60 tulune Lebekadi mihiŋiyat yanagikuk.
Kaŋ mihiyat adi hatigane bediŋa Esau adi kidit molo tiŋa kale behepneŋ yauyau diniŋ mebi mohinek nadiguk. Unduŋ tiŋa behepneŋ kaka yauluguk. Yakobo adi me kwelemaaŋ ala yopmaŋgoŋ hatiluguk
Aisak adi behepneŋ kaledok nadigalika tuluguk doktiŋa weleŋdi Esau kahile tuluguk. Eŋ Lebeka adi Yakobo weleŋdi kahile hinek tuguk.
Heleŋniŋ Yakobo adi hinaŋ hatiguk. Kaŋ Esau adi behepneŋ yauge yauge map kisaŋ nadiŋa busuwaaŋ gweheye tiŋa
Yakobo indiŋ niŋguk, “Nemek giminiŋ i neeŋ pilap nambune nawe. Nu map kisaŋ hinek nadilat.” Unduŋ doktiŋa wou niŋ Edom yogiŋ.
Kaŋ Yakobodibo yoguk, “Mihi tuwo diniŋ kahaŋ u nutok nambeŋ.”
Yobune Esaudibo mede indiŋ tubuudanemiŋguk, “Yakalaŋ! Yoŋ adi map kisaŋ nadiŋa agaŋ kumuŋ tibe tilat. Mihi tuwo diniŋ kahaŋdi maŋgoŋ momooŋ tinambaak?

Iŋgoŋ oŋ Yakobodi yoguk, “Timeŋ yofolok hinek tinambune gabuŋa.” Yobune agaŋ Esaudi Mihi tuwo diniŋ kahaŋ u Yakobodok titindok yofolok fafaŋeniŋ tiŋa Yakobodi nemek giminiŋ heguk wondok tuwaŋiŋ miŋguk.
Kaŋ Yakobo adi Esau belet eŋ kahak giminiŋ heguk u mimbune naguk. Nadapmaaŋ pilale uguk. Esau adi unduŋ tiŋa mihi tuwo diniŋ kahaŋ u sigilulum tuguk.
